limits: Fixtures and approvals are synthetic; source truth, human identity, competence and causal effect are not authenticated.
The structural lineage check does not prove that evidence content supports the inference or decision; that needs independent review.
Missing metric_key or unit on evidence remains provisional support; reviewers must judge semantic relevance and any conversion or derived metric.
The clean smoke covers the exercised CLI and MCP routes, not every possible state or failure.
The sealed 21-injection bank, field intervention and confirmatory model comparison remain pending.
